title: Wagyu's XMR1 token drained from deployer account and sold, Cryptoticker reports; founder promises compensation
geo_basis: no location of Wagyu is stated in the source; placeholder coordinates
summary: Cryptoticker reports that on 20 November an attacker drained XMR1 tokens from the deployer account of Wagyu, a Monero swap service, and sold them on Hyperliquid; per Bitquery, 369.623 XMR1 were sold by 11:28 German time. Founder PerpetualCow says the deployer key was on an old server at hoster 1984. He promised to compensate anyone who lost money.
plain: A token tied to a Monero swap service was reportedly drained and sold off. The founder says he will compensate anyone who lost money.
exec: A swap service's token was reportedly drained and sold; the founder has promised compensation.
impact: Per Bitquery, 369.623 XMR1 were sold by 11:28 German time; native Monero was reportedly not affected.

evidence.quote: verkaufte der Angreifer laut Bitquery bis 11:28 Uhr 369.623 XMR1 für 13,51 Millionen Dollar

validation.note: Only Cryptoticker read; it relays Bitquery, The Block, DV and the founder's own post. The founder's statement is his account only; no second publisher read.

review.note: tag fraud removed (not supported by source); figure kept in the page's German notation; rest matches Cryptoticker
